tests.scenario: Given the flatMap over sceneSpec.objects typed as SceneSpec['objects'][number], when the ids list is built, then it is non-empty and no id or asset appears quoted in BootScene.ts or renderContext.ts

units.title: Verify: Fallback test types the particles mock

tests.id: bootSceneFallback.test.ts::passes the resolved fallback key as the dust particle texture
tests.name: createPhaserEffectContext fallback key usage > passes the resolved fallback key as the dust particle texture
tests.title: Passes the resolved fallback key as the dust particle texture
tests.scenario: Given a scene whose particles factory is a typed vi.fn, When a dust effect with a missing asset is created, Then calls[0][2] equals the fallback key and the emitter depth is set to 3
tests.detail: Passes after the typed mock change; calls[0][2] is FALLBACK.

tests.id: bootSceneFallback.test.ts::returns the asset id itself when the manifest knows it and it has not failed
tests.name: BootScene resolveKey fallback > returns the asset id itself when the manifest knows it and it has not failed
tests.title: Returns the asset id itself when the manifest knows it and it has not failed
tests.scenario: Given a manifest that lists objects/bed, When resolveKey is called with objects/bed, Then it returns objects/bed

tests.id: bootSceneFallback.test.ts::returns the fallback key for an id the manifest does not know
tests.name: BootScene resolveKey fallback > returns the fallback key for an id the manifest does not know
tests.title: Returns the fallback key for an id the manifest does not know
tests.scenario: Given a manifest without nope, When resolveKey is called with nope, Then it returns the fallback key

tests.id: bootSceneFallback.test.ts::returns the fallback key once the loader reports the asset as failed
tests.name: BootScene resolveKey fallback > returns the fallback key once the loader reports the asset as failed
tests.title: Returns the fallback key once the loader reports the asset as failed
tests.scenario: Given the loader emits loaderror for objects/bed, When resolveKey is called with objects/bed, Then it returns the fallback key
